unit: Create ConflictNotices Tab / Decide (read before mutate)
description: The tab-creation migration must inventory every tab first and refuse outright if a tab named ConflictNotices already exists.
why_it_exists: A second run of a one-shot tab migration would otherwise addSheet over, or alongside, a ConflictNotices tab that already holds live conflict-notice rows. The whole migration is gated on a prior GET of the spreadsheet's sheet inventory (built 2026-08-22).

expect.refusal: ConflictNotices already exists. Refusing to create or overwrite it.

assertions: When any existing tab title equals 'ConflictNotices' exactly (case sensitive), safe_to_create is false.
The IF node routes to the Refused branch, so no addSheet batchUpdate and no header PUT is ever issued.
The refusal carries the existing tab's sheetId, index and grid size so a human can see what it refused to touch.
The inventory taken before the decision is returned with the refusal.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
